ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large bifurcated high-intensity regions centered on both lobes; left lobe contains a roughly sub-triangular white region bounded by low-intensity margins; right lobe contains an elongated high-intensity region extending towards the right tip; transition zones exhibit high-frequency pixel mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the dorsal-most boundary; localized jagged discontinuities on the left lobe distal trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex upper margins curving towards acute distal tips; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced horizontal elongation compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-intensity circular points localized on the far-left distal tip and a single prominent circular high-intensity point on the far-right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating a potential tissue loss event.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency salt-and-pepper mottling patterns along the interior boundary of the low-intensity central area, particularly near the median notch.
